milestones.label: Starter loop

source.method: MVT.decodeTile → WorldGen.rasterizeTile → MapScene.spawnInTile; same roaming setup as tools/map-distribution.js

assumptions.strategy: Exploration with occasional backtracking; interact with every discovered modeled reward once; successfully defeat discovered enemies.
assumptions.scope: Surface roaming census; Home placed outside sample to avoid mixing starter guarantees into density. No caves, daily restocks, quest rewards, fixed starter rewards, skill gates, combat time or capacity limits. Distance is cumulative in-game walking, not radius from Home.
assumptions.caveat: Uniform encounter exposure is an assumption, not a pathfinding simulation. Roads, clusters and player choices cause variation; 40 m search width and 70% efficiency are tunable estimates.
assumptions.combatNote: Every encountered enemy is defeated by the player and its coins collected; actual bounties, fixed drops and eligible 10% bonus rolls. The first elite of each kind grants a memory, subsequent elites grant treasure; no prior discoveries.
assumptions.roadNote: Normal non-Runner, keyboard/stick walking; 70% of travel restores new street, credited at shipping 40%; no scenic/boots bonuses. Road thresholds are conditional estimates.
